changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: create or alter view [dbo].[AssetDetail] as select A.ID, A.AssetTypeID, A.AssetTypeUid, A.State, A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.SourceID, ADV.DisplayValue, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.AssetTypeClass, A.AssetTypeDescription, A.TypeName, A.Type, A.TypeID, A.BackColor, A.ForeColor, A.Icon, A.[uid] from AssetWithType A inner join AssetDisplayValue ADV on ADV.AssetID = A.ID where A.[Object] != 'FusionAttribute'
changeSet.rollback: create or alter view [dbo].[AssetDetail] as select A.ID, A.AssetTypeID, A.AssetTypeUid, A.State, A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.SourceID, ADV.DisplayValue, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.AssetTypeClass, A.AssetTypeDescription, A.TypeName, A.Type, A.TypeID, A.BackColor, A.ForeColor, A.Icon, A.[uid] from AssetWithType A inner join AssetDisplayValue ADV on ADV.AssetID = A.ID where A.[Object] != 'FusionAttribute' union all select A.ID, A.AssetTypeID, A.AssetTypeUid, A.State, A.Object, A.ObjectID, A.SourceID, FA.[Name] as DisplayValue, A.CreatedOn, A.CreatedBy, A.UpdatedOn, A.UpdatedBy, A.AssetTypeClass, A.AssetTypeDescription, A.TypeName, A.Type, A.TypeID, A.BackColor, A.ForeColor, A.Icon, A.[uid] from AssetWithType A inner join dbo.FusionAttribute FA on (FA.ID = A.ObjectID and A.[Object] = 'FusionAttribute')
